titulo: Quiz — The dish you were not going to order
subtitulo: Four words, two families and one question
introPt: A traveller puts down the laminated menu, asks what came out of the pots this morning, and orders from the spoken list.
cenario: A table by the door at lunchtime, a photo menu in your hand and a glass counter of trays by the till.

dialogo.pt: We have pot dishes and things grilled to order.
Today we have stuffed vegetables and briám.

perguntas.pergunta: Ταβέρνα, εστιατόριο, ουζερί and ψησταριά are:
opcoes: Four legal categories with different licences
A commercial and customary distinction — food-safety law files them all together
Ranked by price, from cheapest to dearest
Regional names for exactly the same thing
perguntas.explica: Greek food-safety law groups them all as επιχειρήσεις μαζικής εστίασης under the notification regime of law 4442/2016. The words tell you what menu and what register to expect, and nothing official.

perguntas.pergunta: What is the difference between μαγειρευτά and «της ώρας»?
opcoes: Cooked earlier in trays and pots, versus grilled to order
Hot versus cold
For sharing versus individual
House-made versus bought in
perguntas.explica: Magireftá sat and got better; tis óras goes on the grill when you ask. Éhete magireftá names a whole family in two words.

perguntas.pergunta: Bread arrives that you did not order, and it appears on the bill. What is the rule?
opcoes: Cover charge is legal in Greece if it is declared
Bread is always free by law
Cover charge is prohibited, and nothing may be served and charged without prior consent
It depends on the region
perguntas.explica: Article 72 of the ΔΙ.Ε.Π.Π.Υ. rules bars κουβέρ and requires prior consent for any product, bread and bottled water included, at €500 an item. Bread offered and accepted is a normal chargeable item.

perguntas.pergunta: «Μπορώ να δω;» in this part is taught as:
opcoes: Proof that visitors are expected in Greek kitchens
A sentence you can say — the course makes no claim about kitchen customs
A phrase reserved for market stalls
A way to ask for the bill
perguntas.explica: The kitchen custom repeated in travel writing has no source behind it, so the course teaches the sentence and not the custom.

perguntas.pergunta: Which question gets you off the laminated menu fastest?
opcoes: Πόσο κάνει;
Τι έχετε σήμερα;
Είστε ανοιχτά;
Πού είναι η τουαλέτα;
perguntas.explica: Today's list is shorter than the menu and it is usually spoken, not printed. Follow it with τι μας προτείνετε; and the room chooses for you.
